entities.name: Enrique Piñeyro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Enrique Piñeyro is an Argentine-Italian film actor, producer, crash analyst, aeronautical physician, film director, screenplay writer and retired airline pilot working partly in Argentina. Piñeyro owns Aquafilms, a film production company in Argentina.
